title: Purpose vocabulary reduction, dom-taxonomy-v2 to dom-purposes-v5
rationale: Support is the union of the two v4 annotators' positive observations over the 375 pilot-pool nodes (Luna label sets, Jev Noul probability >= 0.75). Everything at or above 10 is retained; everything below is dropped, because a label neither annotator used ten times in 375 nodes cannot be measured, and each retained label costs one Noul question per node per request. Dropping is reversible: restore a label here and bump the prompt revision.

supportWindow.pool: diverse-500-v1 validation + train-QA nodes with both v4 annotators present

unknownHandling: The purposes `unknown` singleton is dropped as a label. Abstention on this axis is an omitted observation, and ruling every purpose out is a complete observation with an empty label list. Section 5 of policy-v5.md states the same rule to both annotators.
scoringNote: A v4 label set is projected onto v5 by discarding dropped labels before comparison. That is generous to v4 on rows whose only disagreement was a dropped label; the pilot reports v4 agreement both on the raw v4 vocabulary and on the projected vocabulary so the effect of the reduction is separable from the effect of the definitions.
